Hi Claire —

Thanks for sending the SOW and for the call earlier. Short answers up front: we can provision a pilot credit package for accepted accelerator companies once the identity and program acceptance evidence is received and a short activation form is signed. Typical checklist we need:

1) Accelerator acceptance letter or program email from the accelerator (PDF).
2) A one-page SOW or link to the repo where we'll be onboarding (you sent this — perfect).
3) Expected monthly token usage estimate (approx. tokens/day or API calls).
4) Confirmation on data classification (PII/regulated) so we can advise on Private vs Hosted.

I've attached our standard trial terms and a SOC2 summary you can share with legal. If everything looks good, we can get the activation form over (DocuSign) and schedule a 30-min kickoff + demo.

Proposed next steps:
- You upload accelerator acceptance letter to this thread.
- Fill the short usage estimate template (I can paste below).
- I’ll loop in Marissa (program) and Mateo (finance) to confirm dollar-equivalent credit and timing.

Proposed demo slots: 2027-10-19 10:00am PT, 2027-10-19 2:00pm PT. Book via https://calendly.com/olga-p/30min if either works.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Olga / Marissa —

I'm fine with the staged provisioning approach. Finance prefers to avoid credit without a signed commercial order, but a gated sandbox credit (30% of the package) is an acceptable exception for accelerators if Marketing/Programs attest they meet the accelerator criteria. Please capture acceptance evidence in HubSpot (HS-1234567890).

Marissa: recommend Starter+ given their token estimate and stated roadmap — that'll give them headroom and reduces churn risk. If we go Starter+ ($30k equiv), gating breakdown could be: 30% release on sandbox, 40% on DocuSign signature, remaining 30% on first usage milestone (100k tokens consumed).

If legal needs the MSA, we can run an expedited review, but don't hold provisioning — do the sandbox.

— Mateo
